findings.detail: Form 117 set to None near a TODO comment -- not an actual fix: form_117_filed=None,  # TODO: separate from instrument field
findings.suggested_fix: Implement the real Form 117 data source (lookup against RJSC filings table or NLC import). Use UNKNOWN until verified, do NOT default to None.

findings.detail: Approval evidence collapsed via truthiness: `bool(t.board_approval`. None (unknown) and False (confirmed no) become indistinguishable.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `if not board_approval:` with explicit 3-valued logic: if board_approval is None -> UNKNOWN; elif board_approval is False -> NON_COMPLIANT; else COMPLIANT.
